Package parking.domain.exception

package parking.domain.exception
Business-rule exceptions raised by the domain layer.

All of them extend BusinessException, forming a shallow hierarchy that lets callers catch broadly (BusinessException) or narrowly (a specific subclass) as needed.

  • Exception Classes
    Class
    Description
    BusinessException
    Common root of every business-rule violation raised by the parking lot domain.
    IncompatibleSpaceException
    Thrown when attempting to assign a space whose SpaceType does not match the vehicle's required type.
    NoAvailableSpaceException
    Thrown when there is no available, compatible space to assign to an entering vehicle.
    SpaceNotAvailableException
    Root exception for the cases where one specific, already-identified space cannot be assigned to a vehicle.
    SpaceOccupiedException
    Thrown when attempting to assign a space that is already OCCUPIED by another vehicle.
    SpaceOutOfServiceException
    Thrown when attempting to assign a space that is marked OUT_OF_SERVICE.
    TicketNotActiveException
    Thrown when attempting to register an exit for a vehicle that has no currently active ticket.
    TicketStillActiveException
    Thrown when attempting to pay a ticket that has not been closed yet (business rule: "an active ticket cannot be paid").
    VehicleWithActiveTicketException
    Thrown when a vehicle attempts to check in while it already has an ACTIVE ticket open (assignment rule: "a vehicle cannot have two active tickets").
